name: AARISE
notes: Official Jobs page invites spontaneous applications and provides a form; asks for a CV and portfolio/showreel. Studio is in La Rochelle; listed roles are on-site or hybrid.

name: Abyssal Interactive
notes: Official careers page invites spontaneous applications if no listed role fits. Current freelance roles are remote; speculative applicant eligibility is not stated.

name: Aden Interactive
notes: Official careers page invites spontaneous applications for roles in Portugal or remote, including full-time, part-time, contract and freelance.

name: Aethra Studios
notes: Official careers page invites open applications with a portfolio or work samples. Remote across Europe with CET overlap; specific roles are also listed.

name: Artefacts Studio
notes: Official careers page explicitly invites spontaneous applications and provides an application route. Studio address is in Villeurbanne, France.

name: Aska Studios
notes: Official site invites CV and portfolio emails for developers, artists, designers and other contributors. Reykjavík-based studio describes a remote-first work environment.

name: Asobo Studio
notes: Official Lever Speculative Application accepts candidates whose skills do not match a listed role. Full-time, on-site in Bordeaux; portfolio encouraged.

name: Awe Interactive
notes: Official careers page has a Speculative Application section and invites candidates to contact careers@aweinteractive.com. Work location and eligibility are unstated.

name: Bananagun
notes: Official site describes a small, senior mobile game team building hyper- and hybrid-casual Unity games for iOS and Android; current careers section invites open applications. HQ is not publicly stated.

name: Barnstorm Games
notes: Dedicated Speculative Application page invites applications from candidates who do not see the right role advertised. Company registered in England and Wales.

name: Beenox
notes: Official careers FAQ explicitly confirms spontaneous applications and invites CVs. Full-time roles only; studio locations include Québec City and Montréal.

name: Blowfish Studios
notes: Official Open Application asks applicants without a matching role to email a resume. Preferred locations are Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne and/or remote.

name: Bossa Studios
notes: Official careers page invites speculative resumes, says the studio is 100% remote, and shows a speculative application open to all departments any time. Official route describes eligibility as worldwide.

name: Brave At Night
notes: Official page is titled Speculative Application and asks applicants to send a CV and portfolio if possible.

name: Chimera Entertainment
notes: Official Personio posting is titled speculative application; it says applicants who did not find a fitting role can apply anyway. Munich office. Work model: onsite.

name: CI Games
notes: Official Open Application welcomes candidates even if no exact role is listed. Marked Worldwide and Fully Remote; considers current or future project needs.

name: CraftiGames
notes: Official careers page invites open applications beyond listed roles. Small, fully remote Minecraft studio; typical roles specify a GMT ±6-hour window.

name: Cyanide Studio
notes: Official careers page invites spontaneous applications when no listed role fits. The page's Apply button leads to an external application form; French-language route.

name: Dionic Software
notes: Official jobs page invites speculative approaches when no role fits. Employment is Germany-only; freelancers can usually work from European time zones. Work model: remote.

name: DON'T NOD (Montreal)
notes: Official SmartRecruiters Spontaneous Application for DON'T NOD Montreal. Invites applications when the career site has no matching role; Montreal-specific.

name: Ember Crows
notes: Official Spontaneous Application accepts worldwide applicants. Caveat: project-based freelance with points-based profit share, no guaranteed upfront salary or fee.

name: Fawkes Games
notes: Official careers page invites spontaneous applications and says remote work can be done from anywhere. Some freelance roles prefer Europe-friendly time zones. Official route describes eligibility as worldwide.

name: Frima Studio
notes: Official Québec careers page lists a Spontaneous Application and invites interested candidates to send an English CV and cover letter.

name: Funday Games
notes: Official listing invites unsolicited CVs when no role matches. Listed as hybrid in Aarhus, Denmark; broader applicant-country eligibility is not stated.

name: Futureplay Games
notes: Official Open Application covers general disciplines and explicitly lists Remote: Global for people passionate about the game industry.

name: G7 Studio
notes: Saudi-based G7 Studio has a General Application for game development and future opportunities; roles and working arrangements can be discussed if there's a fit.

name: Hindsight Studios
notes: Invites speculative applications when no listed position fits, with a speculative-application option on its official careers form. Location and country eligibility should be confirmed directly.

name: HypeHype
notes: Official jobs page lists an Open Application for people interested in AI-native games and game creation; studio is in Helsinki and eligibility is unstated. Work model: onsite.

name: Hypemasters
notes: Branded open-application page welcomes a resume even when no suitable listed position fits. Applicant-country eligibility and work arrangements are not specified.

name: Katal Games
notes: Official careers page says there are no open roles but welcomes open applications by email with a CV or portfolio and a note about the candidate's interests.

name: Keen Software House
notes: Official spontaneous-application route for candidates who do not fit a listed opening. Remote applications are considered with CET overlap; the studio is looking for experienced, senior people rather than juniors.

name: Kinetic Games
notes: Official ATS route welcomes speculative applications across disciplines. Hybrid in Southampton; applicants must already have UK right to work and sponsorship is unavailable. Eligible locations: United Kingdom.

name: Kuuasema
notes: Official Open Application for Helsinki hybrid roles. Accepts EU/EEA/Swiss citizens or people already authorised to work in Finland; no visa sponsorship.

name: Kylotonn
notes: Official careers page explicitly links to an unsolicited application. Use the studio's application form; location and eligibility conditions are not stated on the route.

name: Lighthouse Games
notes: Dedicated Speculative Application invites candidates who do not see a matching role. Full-time, on-site in Royal Leamington Spa; studio says it is looking for top talent.

name: LIQUIDBULLET Studios
notes: Official page says 'Apply anyway', is open to all departments, fully remote and reviewed all year; it describes its speculative application process. Official route describes eligibility as worldwide.

name: Lost Boys Interactive
notes: Studio-owned careers portal lists a General Application. The studio describes itself as remote-first across the United States and Canada; confirm eligibility for the specific role or application.

name: Lunacy Studios
notes: Official careers page describes a fully remote, globally distributed indie studio and invites General Applications when no role fits. Country eligibility is unstated.

name: Obsidian Entertainment
notes: Official General Application accepts candidates who do not find a matching opening, across art, design, animation, production, programming and other disciplines. Remote work is mentioned; country eligibility is not stated.

name: Ocellus Studio
notes: Official careers page invites CVs if no open position fits. Most work is Lyon-based; some roles allow remote from Lyon. Unsolicited eligibility is not stated.

name: Octocube Games
notes: Official Careers page invites Unsolicited Applications. The studio contact form includes an 'Unsolicited Application' topic. Based in Roskilde, Denmark.

name: Old Skull Games
notes: Official careers page says it is always meeting good people and links a Spontaneous Application for candidates whose role is not listed.

name: Outplay Entertainment
notes: Official ATS route for speculative applications when no specific role fits. Listed as flexi-hybrid with remote options in the UK/EU. Eligible locations: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, United Kingdom.

name: Paintbucket Games
notes: Official Jobs page lists an Unsolicited Application and says to apply even when no current job offer fits. Full-time; studio is based in Berlin.

name: Plummy Games
notes: Official company page identifies Chișinău, Moldova as its home base (about 25 teammates in the office) and lists Tallinn, Estonia among remote-work locations. Open application; fully remote options, with B2B conditions for some countries.

name: Raw Power Games
notes: Official ATS listing titled Unsolicited Application; remote work is limited to time zones roughly 1–2 hours from Copenhagen.

name: Redly Games
notes: Official Ashby General Interest application welcomes candidates without a matching role. Global remote; EU and Canada preferred, others considered by role.

name: Reply Game Studios
notes: Official page invites spontaneous applications by email. Requires fluent English and Italian and availability to work on site in Milan, Italy. Work model: onsite.

name: Rustling Leaves Games
notes: Official General Application invites future-role applications across disciplines. Important caveat: the studio states its work is rev-share-based.

name: Sanuk Games
notes: The official careers page says CVs are considered even when no position is listed. Work-from-home roles; follow the page instructions and include a portfolio where relevant.

name: Sencorp Games
notes: Official careers page lists Open application alongside role listings; the studio describes its work model as remote-friendly.

name: SOFTGAMES
notes: Official Unsolicited Application welcomes candidates without a matching role. Remote-first company asks for an English CV and cover letter; country eligibility is not specified.

name: Speedway Games
notes: Official General Application is for experienced contributors whose skills do not match a listed role. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis; location is Global.

name: Squeeze Studio
notes: Official Recruitee listing welcomes applications when no listed specialty matches; options include on-site, remote or hybrid around Montréal and Québec, Canada.

name: Stormind Games
notes: Official careers page offers a spontaneous-application form when no listed role fits; candidates can attach a CV and portfolio. Work model is not stated.

name: Studios DRAMA / UNRECORD
notes: Official unsolicited form covers art, programming, design, production, audio, QA and more; applicants explain why they want to work on UNRECORD.

name: SumiGamesStudio
notes: Official careers page hires ahead of need and welcomes introductions by email when no opening fits. Remote-friendly game, XR and partner projects; eligibility is unstated.

name: Supermassive Games
notes: Official page titled Speculative Application invites applicants whose experience fits even when no listed role does. Guildford, UK.

name: The Indie Stone
notes: Accepts speculative applications across programming, design, writing, art and other game-development disciplines. Fully remote worldwide; good written English required.

name: Third Kind Games
notes: Official careers page asks applicants to send their CV and details as a speculative application when no current role fits.

name: Unknown Worlds
notes: Official Greenhouse General Application accepts candidates for future opportunities. Team is globally distributed; eligible hiring countries are not listed. Work model: remote.

name: Uplift Games
notes: Official General Application for future opportunities. Remote-first, but applicants must live in and have permission to work in the US or UK. Eligible locations: United States, United Kingdom.

name: VestGames
notes: Official Unsolicited Application accepts candidates when no role is open. On-site, hybrid or remote; English required, German for full-time roles.

name: Vyrex Interactive
notes: Official careers page says there are no open roles right now but accepts speculative applications from people who believe they fit.

name: Yabu Games
notes: Official careers page invites applications beyond listed roles; applicants choose Open application in the form. Studio office is in Istanbul. Work model: hybrid.
